changes: Added read-only Lattice parallel operator projections in packages/main/src/core/lattice-parallel-wave.ts, handlers in packages/main/src/handlers/lattice-parallel-wave.ts, CLI schemas in packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts, policy/fact/default-phase registrations, focused smoke coverage, and docs clarifying JSON contracts plus dev-memory as the existing project public experience library.
usage: Run node bin/koala.js parallel_dispatch --storyIds="[\"B-e70f\"]" --includeExperience=true --format=json, or parallel_status, parallel_merge_queue, and parallel_report for read-only planning output. These commands are planning surfaces only and do not spawn agents or satisfy authority gates.
expectedOutcome: The local CLI exposes parallel_dispatch, parallel_status, parallel_merge_queue, and parallel_report as read-only JSON operator surfaces. Outputs show dispatch guidance, merge guidance, evidence refs, optional non-authoritative dev-memory refs, spawned=false, requiresRunnerConfirmation=true, productionDone=false, authorityChanged=false, and receiptRefs empty.
actualTranscript: User acceptance commands ran successfully from the B-e70f worktree: parallel_dispatch returned koala.parallel_dispatch.v1 with B-e70f dispatchable, spawned=false, requiresRunnerConfirmation=true, experienceRefs gateEvidence=false and authority non_authoritative; parallel_status returned B-e70f as ready; parallel_merge_queue returned B-e70f ready with checklist evidence refs; parallel_report returned evidenceSummary and non-authoritative experienceRefs. koala validate passed with 15/15 verification intents covered. Full transcript is .koala/story/actives/B-e70f/evidence/transcript-diff.md.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible gap found. Actual CLI output matched the expected read-only planning behavior and preserved the authority boundary; the only warning is the expected host receipt-verification limitation, which is outside this story scope.
limitations: The new commands are local planning projections only. They do not auto-spawn Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, or Mac runners; they do not change Python authority receipt semantics; and dev-memory is bounded context, not gate evidence.
pitfalls: A docs reviewer found an overstated JSON contract in lattice-parallel-wave.md, so the story returned to DEV and split base wave JSON from projection-specific JSON. Koala validate updates tracked test-evidence.json, so stale evidence was refreshed before final review. Global koala may still need local install or merge before old shells see these new commands.
